_comment: Batch planning rules for tools/windows/sync-inventory.ps1; see docs/WINDOWS-UPSTREAM-SYNC.md#batching. Paths are PowerShell -like patterns ('*' also matches '/'). A commit is convergence or timing if any changed path matches; src/ files changed by a known regression's revert also count as timing. shared marks non-inert files listed in shared-edits.json. A commit that is neither convergence nor timing is inert if every path matches the inert patterns, otherwise contained. A batch ends at a release commit unless it holds no convergence or timing commit, and ends early when the next commit would exceed a limit.

convergence.checks: Decide fork-or-upstream for each overlapping implementation, review every affected compatibility contract, and run the Windows CPU gate plus the Windows HIP build.

timing.checks: Run matched Windows timing controls for the affected models, including the first-request control, at the per-request 5% and 3 ms gates. On failure, revert-test only this batch's timing commits.

shared.checks: Review the fork's edits in the listed shared files and their contracts, even when the merge is clean.

contained.checks: Run the bounded Windows CPU gate and the affected functional suites.

inert.checks: Run the documentation, formatting and build checks only.
